integrity.literature_boundary: The valid vector-frame predecessor is mathematically distinct from postcomposition of generalized-frame coefficient maps.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional projection counterexample, structural coefficient-range lemma, and an onto-analysis sufficient repair in the ordinary g-frame case.
integrity.unproved_limits: No complete characterization of coefficient families ensuring invertibility for general dense-range K is asserted.

scientific_limitations: Proper closed coefficient-range span permits a counterexample but the full-span condition alone is not sufficient to restore the original theorem.
The analysis-surjectivity repair is for K=I and identical coefficient spaces, not an arbitrary K-g-frame.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark or other correction could contain the same projection example.
title: Coefficient-range projections refute an operator invertibility theorem for generalized frames
